title: Studio 菜单（M1）：修订 ADR-0084——左侧菜单加「常用 / 高级」两层，类型表加顺序和层级两列
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Part of #36890. Ruling: #37192, comment 7151834490 (maintainer 「同意」, with adjustments 7151811337). Proposal: 7151777190 §3.1–§3.9. The maintainer asked for these cards to be dispatched first: 「相关任务立卡优先派发处理」.

## What

Amend `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md` in place.

1. Replace the 2026-11-24 amendment's sentence "the menu draws no audience tier" (`:76`, `:190`) with the ruled two tiers, quoting the maintainer's words from #37192:
   - **常用**: always listed on a package.
   - **高级**: one collapsed fold that holds everything else.
2. Write the sorting rule from proposal §3.1. A type is 常用 when all three hold: it has no required parent object, a builder makes it directly, and it stays inside the package. A type with no row in the table falls into 高级; it never becomes invisible.
3. Add two columns to the type → group table, **order** and **tier**, in the ruled order:
   - 数据: 对象
   - 界面: 应用 · 页面 · 仪表盘 · 报表
   - 自动化: 流程
   - 访问: 权限集
   - AI: 智能体 · 工具 · 技能, the last visible group
   - every other type: 高级, in the proposal's order. This includes 选项列表, 邮件模板 and 默认共享.

The six groups of decision 11 stay as they are. ADR-0146 D1 needs no edit, because it defers the menu to ADR-0084.

## Done when

- The ADR's text and table state exactly the ruled tiers and order.
- Nothing else is touched.

## Notes

- Governed path (`docs/adr/**`), so Tier H: after ACCEPT the seat hands it to the maintainer.
- Runs in parallel with M2 and with the open Studio PRs; none of them touches `docs/adr/`.
- Size S.
